g.text: GALINI · L01 · bounded arrival / information comparisons
Same neighboring districts retained / selected variants remain subject to independent local review
Rejected: direct bridge-to-Fountain alignment gives the reserve broad through-support,
but combines crossing observation with district reinforcement.
Selected: O03 blocks the bridge stance from both receiving exits. A follower at
(82,54,+4) can shift south to trade the leader around the tip; retreat remains
Rejected: an undivided upper terrace can combine bridge information with A local-ascent
Selected: M08 separates (47,91,+8) from A. Crossers can circle north to A or descend S4;
direct support across that building is lost.
Information variant: upper bridge south edge is a 2.4 m opaque wall with only W02 at x61–64, sill +1.1 / head +2.1. An open 1.1 m rail along the whole edge was declined: it
would make the entire span a middle-bridge overlook. The selected aperture preserves one useful reciprocal observation at the cost of occupying the span and turning away from
